# GitHub-style line selection and a big composer in a resizable review panel (run page)

## What to build

On the single-run web page (`src/web/page.html`), the final human-review diff, its comments and the Apply / Request changes / Drop buttons move from the `#reviewdiff` section above the graph into the right side panel (`aside#panel`). The panel gets a drag handle on its left edge and opens wide for review.

The review diff gets GitHub-style line selection:

- hover a line to show a `+` button in its gutter, and click it to select that line
- drag along the gutter, or shift-click a second `+`, to select a range
- the range may cover added, context **or deleted** lines

A big inline composer then opens under the last selected line. It posts the range with the fields the previous slice added to the API:

```
POST /review/comments {file, side, startLine, endLine, snippet, body, liveCheck}
```

The selection and anchor logic lives in a new shared browser module, `src/web/assets/comments.js`, served by a new `GET /assets/*` route on **both** servers. The suite page mounts the same module in a later slice.

The previous slice delivered the API side:

- `commentSchema` in `src/review/human.ts` has `side: "new"|"old"`, `startLine` and `endLine`
- a legacy `line` is normalized to a one-line new-side range, so `GET /review` comments never carry `line`
- both servers accept the new fields

Markdown preview, suggestions, the comments list and the earlier-round inline threads are **not** part of this slice. Keep today's `commentView` / `previousCard` rendering for saved comments, placing a line comment after the row of its `endLine` on its side.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/page.html`:
  - L59–80: `#main.withpanel` grid (`minmax(0,1fr) min(520px,45vw)`) and `#panel` CSS
  - L109–118: `#reviewdiff` CSS; the textarea `min-height:56px` is at L111
  - L138–141: markup for `#review`, `#reviewdiff`, `#main`, `#graph` and `aside#panel`
- `src/web/page.html` L404–462: `postReview`, `hasOpenComments`, `syncRequestChanges` and `renderReview` (the decision buttons, `id="request-changes"`)
- `src/web/page.html` L464–669: the review client.
  - `rv` state, `loadReview` (GET /review), `syncReviewDiff`, `sendComment(method, path, body, errBox)`, `commentForm`, `commentView`, `addComment`
  - `previousCard`, `previousComments`
  - `reviewRow(f)`: L612–617 `place()` puts a saved comment after `[data-new-line=N]`; L618–622 is the `fillDiff` onLine callback
  - `renderReviewDiff()`
- `src/web/page.html` L736–784: `diffLine(cls, oldNo, newNo, mark, content)` builds `div.dl.<cls>` > `div.ln`(old), `div.ln`(new), `div.mk`, `span.code`. `fillDiff(pre, data, path, onLine)` parses hunks. Only new-side rows get `d.dataset.newLine`, and the `.pick` handler is at L753–764.
- `src/web/page.html` L861–930: `renderPanel(s)` shows or hides `#panel` and toggles `#main.withpanel`. L1018–1029: the `render(s)` order.
- `src/web/server.ts`:
  - L89: `pageFile = new URL("./page.html", import.meta.url)`
  - L121–128: the `Route` type, `json()` helper and `"GET /"` handler
  - L365–415: `handle()` with the prefix dispatch before the table, and the 404/405 fallback with the `known` list at L413
- `src/suite/server.ts` L256–289: `handle()`; `allowedMethod` (L281–284) returns 404 for anything not listed, so `/assets/*` must be dispatched before it.
- `package.json` L35: `postbuild` copies only the two `page.html` files to `dist/web` and `dist/suite`.
- `tsconfig.json`: `include: ["src/**/*.ts","src/**/*.tsx"]` and no `allowJs`. `eslint.config.js` has no browser globals.
- `src/web/server.test.ts` L120–127: the page test (`content-type text/html; charset=utf-8`, `/nope` → 404).

## Patterns to follow

**Shared static route.** Put it in a new `src/web/assets.ts` so both servers use it:
```ts
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import type http from "node:http";

export const ASSETS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("./assets/", import.meta.url));
const TYPES: Record<string, string> = { ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8", ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8", ".woff2": "font/woff2", ".svg": "image/svg+xml", ".json": "application/json" };

/** Serves GET /assets/<path> from `root`; false when the path is not an asset (caller 404s). */
export async function serveAsset(root: string, pathname: string, res: http.ServerResponse): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) return false;
  let rel: string;
  try { rel = decodeURIComponent(pathname.slice("/assets/".length)); } catch { return false; }
  const file = path.resolve(root, rel);
  const type = TYPES[path.extname(file)];
  if (!type || !file.startsWith(path.resolve(root) + path.sep)) return false;
  try {
    const body = await readFile(file);
    res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": type, "cache-control": "no-cache" }).end(body);
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}
```
- The suite server passes `fileURLToPath(new URL("../web/assets/", import.meta.url))`.
- Both servers call it for `GET` only, before their 404 fallback, and 404 when it returns false.

**Build copy.** Append to the `postbuild` inline script:
```
fs.cpSync('src/web/assets','dist/web/assets',{recursive:true})
```

**Browser JS modules.** Plain ES2022 modules, with `// @ts-check` and JSDoc types at the top. Put pure functions (no DOM) first and export them, then the DOM code. Load from the page with:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/comments.css"><script type="module">import * as comments from "/assets/comments.js"; window.comments = comments;</script>
```
or convert the page's script to `type="module"` and import directly. A module script runs deferred, so the classic script that calls `comments.*` must run after it. The simplest approach is to make the page's single script `type="module"` and add `import { mountReviewComments, ... } from "/assets/comments.js";` at its top.

**Tests for browser modules.** Add `"allowJs": true` to `tsconfig.json` `compilerOptions`, without `checkJs`. A vitest file `src/web/assets/comments.test.ts` can then `import { rangeFrom, anchor, snippetFor } from "./comments.js";`. In `eslint.config.js`, add a block for the browser files:
```js
{ files: ["src/web/assets/**/*.js"], rules: { "no-undef": "off" } },
```
and add `"src/web/assets/vendor/"` to `ignores`.

**Rendering contract.** Every diff row must carry the attributes below. This contract is shared with the planned UI redesign, so do not rename them:
```html
<div class="dl add|del|ctx" data-file="src/a.ts" data-kind="add|del|ctx" data-old-line="40" data-new-line="41" data-hunk="2">
```
(`data-old-line` empty on add rows, `data-new-line` empty on del rows.)

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/web/assets.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `ASSETS_DIR` and `serveAsset` as above.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/web/server.ts` and `src/suite/server.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - run server: in `handle()`, before the routes-table lookup, `if (req.method === "GET" && pathname.startsWith("/assets/")) { if (!(await serveAsset(ASSETS_DIR, pathname, res))) res.writeHead(404).end("Not Found"); return; }`
  - suite server: the same, before the `allowedMethod` check, with root `fileURLToPath(new URL("../web/assets/", import.meta.url))`
- **GOTCHA**: keep the Host/Origin guard in front, so it still applies.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server src/suite/server`

### UPDATE `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `eslint.config.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `package.json`: append the `fs.cpSync` step to `postbuild`
  - `tsconfig.json`: `allowJs: true`
  - `eslint.config.js`: the browser-files block and the vendor ignore
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build && ls dist/web/assets/comments.js`

### CREATE `src/web/assets/comments.js`

Export these **pure** functions:

- `rangeFrom(rows, anchorIdx, focusIdx)`: `rows` is an array of `{kind, old, new, hunk, file}`. It returns the inclusive `[from, to]` index range, clipped to the anchor row's file and hunk.
- `anchor(rows)`: takes the selected rows and returns `{side, startLine, endLine}`.
  - Every row is `del` → `side: "old"`, and start and end are the first and last `old` numbers.
  - Otherwise → `side: "new"`, and start and end are the `new` numbers of the first and last non-del rows.
  - An `opts.side` argument forces the side (for a split view later).
- `snippetFor(rows)`: joins the row texts with `\n`, prefixing del rows with `-` and add rows with `+` when the range is mixed. It is capped at 2000 chars; when cut, it ends with `\n… (cut)`.
- `rangeText({side, startLine, endLine})` → `"lines +12 to +18"` / `"line −40"`.

DOM code:

- `mountSelection(container, { onSelect })`:
  - adds a gutter `+` button (`button.addc`) to each `.dl` row: on the new-number cell for add/ctx rows, and on the old-number cell for del rows
  - selection by pointer: pointerdown on `+`, then pointermove (hit-test with `document.elementFromPoint`, throttled with `requestAnimationFrame`), then pointerup → `onSelect({ file, rows, anchor, snippet, lastRow })`. The page auto-scrolls when the pointer is within 40px of the scroll container's top or bottom edge.
  - shift-click on `+` extends the current selection
  - keyboard: with focus on a `+`, Shift+ArrowUp/Down extends the selection and Enter opens the composer
  - selected rows get `.sel`
- `openComposer(afterRow, { title, onSave, onCancel })`:
  - a full-width box with the header `Commenting on <rangeText>` (or `this file` / `the whole change`)
  - a monospace textarea with `rows=8`. It auto-grows on input (`style.height = scrollHeight`) up to 60% of the panel height, then scrolls.
  - a "needs live check" checkbox and Cancel / Comment buttons
  - `⌘/Ctrl+Enter` saves; `Esc` cancels, asking `confirm()` first when the textarea is not empty
  - only one composer is open at a time; opening another while one has text asks first
  - `onSave(body, liveCheck)` returns a Promise<boolean>; the composer closes on true
  - drafts are kept in `sessionStorage` under `ge.draft.<file>.<side>.<start>-<end>`, wrapped in try/catch

### CREATE `src/web/assets/comments.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `.dl .addc`: hidden until the row is hovered or focused; a 16px accent square with `+`
  - `.dl.sel`: a translucent accent background and a 3px accent inset bar on the left
  - `.composer`: the header, textarea (min-height 8 rows, `resize: vertical`), and footer
  - `.panel-resize` handle: 6px, `cursor: col-resize`, a 2px accent line on hover

  Use the page's existing tokens (`--accent`, `--panel`, `--text`, `--muted`).

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `fillDiff` sets the rendering-contract attributes on every row (`data-file`, `data-kind`, `data-old-line`, `data-new-line`, `data-hunk`) and stops computing the "line + 2 before" snippet. `reviewRow` uses `mountSelection` and `openComposer` instead of the `.pick` click and `commentForm`. Saving POSTs this through `sendComment`:

  ```
  {file, side, startLine, endLine, snippet, body, liveCheck}
  ```
- **IMPLEMENT**: `place()` finds the row with `[data-${c.side === "old" ? "old" : "new"}-line="${c.endLine}"]` inside the file's `pre`, and falls back to the file header when it is not found.
- **IMPLEMENT**: review in the panel. While `rv` is loaded (the run is waiting or a past round is shown), `renderPanel` renders a **Review** view in `#panel`:
  - the content of `renderReviewDiff()`
  - the decision buttons from `renderReview`, in a sticky footer (`position: sticky; bottom: 0`)

  Remove `#reviewdiff` from the main flow. The banner text "Waiting for your review" can stay in `#review`, but without the buttons.
  - Clicking a graph node while reviewing switches the panel to that node, with a "← Review" button to go back.
  - When review mode starts, the panel width is `max(60vw, 640px)` capped at 85vw.
- **IMPLEMENT**: the drag handle `div.panel-resize` on the left edge of `#panel`:
  - pointer capture
  - width clamped to 320px … 85vw, and written to `#main`'s `grid-template-columns`
  - double-click resets the width
  - keyboard: `role="separator"`, ArrowLeft/Right move it 32px
  - the width is saved to `localStorage['ge.panel']` as JSON `{width}` (try/catch) and restored on load
- **GOTCHA**: `render(s)` runs on every SSE state. Do not rebuild the review DOM when nothing changed, or an open composer is lost. Today `syncReviewDiff` only re-renders when the round changes. Keep that rule, and never re-render while a composer has text.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then follow TESTING.md "Human review" with agent-browser.

### CREATE `src/web/assets/comments.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: vitest for `rangeFrom` (clips at hunk and file boundaries, works with reversed anchor and focus), `anchor` (all del → old; mixed add/del/ctx → new with the first and last non-del numbers; single ctx row), `snippetFor` (plain, mixed with `+`/`-`, the cap), and `rangeText`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

### UPDATE `src/web/server.test.ts` and `src/suite/server.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `GET /assets/comments.js` → 200 with `text/javascript`
  - `GET /assets/../server.ts` and `GET /assets/%2e%2e/package.json` → 404
  - `GET /assets/nope.js` → 404
  - suite: `GET /assets/comments.css` → 200
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server src/suite/server`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /assets/comments.js` and `/assets/comments.css` → 200 on both servers; traversal attempts → 404
- [ ] `npm run build` puts the assets in `dist/web/assets/`, and the installed CLI serves them
- [ ] When the run waits for review, the review diff, comments and decision buttons are in the right panel, which opens at ≥ 60vw, resizes by dragging (320px…85vw), and keeps its width after a reload
- [ ] The review diff rows carry `data-file/kind/old-line/new-line/hunk`
- [ ] Clicking `+` on one line opens the composer titled `Commenting on line +3`, and saving → POST with `side:"new", startLine:3, endLine:3`
- [ ] Dragging from +2 to +3 → `startLine:2, endLine:3`. Shift-click extends a selection. A selection on deleted rows only → `side:"old"` with old line numbers
- [ ] The composer has ≥ 8 rows and grows, `⌘Enter` saves, and `Esc` cancels (asking first if it has text)
- [ ] A saved comment appears after the row of its `endLine` on its side
- [ ] Unit tests pass: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`
- [ ] Checked in the browser with agent-browser per TESTING.md "Human review", with a screenshot in the report

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/web src/suite/server
npm run build
# then TESTING.md "Human review" with agent-browser: select a range, comment, reload, check round1.json
```
